_what: v4 on its own, with nothing from v1, v2 or v3: Firstmate's Calm (the sailboat while Claude works, tool rows and short narration hidden) on Claude Code's own default look. Calm's colours are upstream's: a Claude-orange boat on spinner-blue water. Claude Code runs its built-in dark theme and draws replies itself (no skins, no prismantis); Windows Terminal runs its built-in Campbell scheme. No status line, no side pane, no glow, no custom spinner words, no tab-title hook. The font-safe sail glyphs and the spinner word beside the boat are v4's own changes to Calm.
label: v4: Firstmate Calm on Claude Code's own look
keptBecauseNotLooks: the JetBrainsMono NFM font and grayscale text (needed for the glyphs; your system-wide display choice)
